branded.description:
Which answers to list, by the prompt as it ran: 'all' (default), 'branded' (the prompt names the brand) or 'non_branded'. Pass the value the overview or rankings used so the list matches their counts. A prompt is branded when its text names the brand: the registrable name of a target domain as a word, case ignored, so 'example' and 'example.com' both name example.com. Branded prompts almost always get answers that mention the brand.

* `all` - All
* `branded` - Branded
* `non_branded` - Non-branded

days.description: Length of the window in days, ending today in the project's timezone. Default 30, at most 90.

domain.description: List the answers that cited a page on this domain or one of its subdomains, case ignored. Takes a host from the overview's top_domains (docs.example.com) or a domain from the rankings (example.com).

engine.description: Only list answers from this answer engine, for example 'claude-web-search'.

include_answer_text.description: Set to true to return each engine's answer in answer_text. Left out by default to keep pages small.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: List the answers whose engine ran this web search. Case and repeated spaces are ignored, as in the overview's top_searches.

url.description: List the answers that cited this exact URL, as it appears in cited_urls or the rankings' top_pages.
